packetRationale: Pre-data grouping of the same 40 selected cells into two non-overlapping five-panel packets to respect v2's 30-minute per-packet hard budget. Each cell is calibrated once with seven pairs/two repeats; packets run sequentially, with no retry, selection dropping or changed noise/window gate. Total campaign hard budget is at most 60 minutes.

separateCpuProfiles.claim: Bounded baseline attribution only; exclude reset/assertions with invocation windows. No candidate timing, exclusive CPU-share or allocation benefit claim.

modeAxisRationale: These calibrated writes and controls have no related-model targets. Only the active operation output mode matters, so timing uses homogeneous iiii/tttt; all 16 tuples remain in real-worker correctness. The diagnostic-only input-subqueries shape does have target READ work and is not timing-deduplicated or calibrated here.
selectionRationale: Direct/public single writes and both UPSERT branches; public wide async native bulk CREATE plus LIST; absent-hook tiny writes; shared bare READ/singleton LIST; native UPDATE by ID/filter; date-marker public writes; narrow-output function-rule wide direct writes. Diagnostic/correctness coverage separately includes both entries for every new input shape, ordinary nesting, static rules and small/wide widths.
retention: No candidate timing or production change in CWO-01. Relevant work reduction plus measured benefit in both affected modes and every required non-regression cell remain mandatory. Unsettled warmup, short windows or noise above the fixed cap block retention; no retry, cell dropping or tolerance widening.
excludedMetrics: heap allocation bytes or retained heap
